create.name: Tara Mulay
create.bio:
Tara Mulay teaches insight meditation in the Burmese Mahasi Sayadaw lineage, with further influence from teachers such as Howard Cohn, Kamala Masters, Joseph Goldstein, Gil Fronsdal and Sayadaw U Tejaniya. She began practising in 2003 and has sat long retreats in the United States and Myanmar. For more than two decades before teaching she worked as a criminal defence lawyer in California, where she was among the leaders of the Mission Dharma group and, in 2016, helped start an insight sangha there for people of colour.

She completed the Insight Meditation Society's 2017–2021 teacher training and now teaches from Western Massachusetts, leading residential retreats at IMS, the Forest Refuge and other centres, along with online programmes. Her Indian heritage shaped her path: she was first drawn to the dharma by the Buddha's refusal to treat caste as a measure of a person's worth. Her teaching stresses a relaxed, receptive kind of mindfulness joined with kindness, and she sees classical practice as a source of strength for marginalised communities. With Devin Berry she runs Heartstream Sangha, a monthly online gathering, and she offers one-to-one practice mentoring on a dana basis.

courses.title: New Year's Eve Retreat 2026
courses.description: A one-day IMS Online retreat on the last day of 2026, taught with Devin Berry. Sessions of mindfulness and lovingkindness run through the afternoon and evening, with an optional sit across midnight Eastern time and a chance to set intentions for the year ahead.

courses.title: Forest Refuge: July 2027 (Heartstream Dharma)
courses.description: A month of personal retreat at the Forest Refuge in Barre, guided by Tara Mulay and Devin Berry, combining vipassana with metta as two complementary trainings. It is meant for experienced meditators, and applicants staying the whole month are given priority.
courses.price: From $115 USD per night (2027 sliding scale $115–$355 per night); full-month stays have priority

courses.title: Heartstream Sangha
courses.description: An online community gathering on the first Sunday of each month, co-led with Devin Berry, with meditation and dharma reflection. It is offered on a donation basis.

courses.title: Practice Mentoring
courses.description: Individual meetings of 30 or 55 minutes for practitioners wanting personal guidance in meditation and daily-life practice, once or on an ongoing basis. Dana and scheduling are arranged after an initial message.

free_resources.title: Dharma Talks on Dharma Seed
free_resources.description: Tara's archive of recorded dharma talks and guided meditations from retreats and sanghas, free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Heartstream Sangha Newsletter
free_resources.description: A free newsletter of dharma writing and news from Tara Mulay and Devin Berry.
